primary_adjudication_shamir_desi_vs_sdss.rationale: Shamir 2022 DESI Legacy axis vs AVE SDSS DR17: separation 39.83 deg = 0.92 sigma_combined < 1 sigma. CATALOG-AGREE: the two catalog/methodology paths consistently report the same axis within 1 sigma joint uncertainty.

DECam.rationale: Shamir 2022 DESI Legacy axis vs AVE SDSS DR17: separation 49.49 deg = 1.18 sigma_combined. CATALOG-MARGINAL: 1 <= sep/sigma_combined <= 2. Both results valid with explicit methodology-uncertainty acknowledged.

SDSS.rationale: Shamir 2022 DESI Legacy axis vs AVE SDSS DR17: separation 74.04 deg = 2.99 sigma_combined > 2 sigma. CATALOG-DISAGREE: methodology systematic dominates; SDSS DR17 axis interpretation needs caveating.

Pan_STARRS.rationale: Shamir 2022 DESI Legacy axis vs AVE SDSS DR17: separation 49.38 deg = 0.87 sigma_combined < 1 sigma. CATALOG-AGREE: the two catalog/methodology paths consistently report the same axis within 1 sigma joint uncertainty.

methodology_systematic_probe_shamir_sdss.interpretation: Shamir's SDSS row uses Ganalyzer on SDSS DR8 imaging; AVE SDSS DR17 uses Longo cos-gamma on GZ1 crowdsourced classification of SDSS DR7. Same input galaxies (broadly), different methodology + classifier. Large separation reflects methodology-systematic at the SDSS-imaging level.

e2_catalog_access_subfinding.description: Shamir 2022 per-galaxy CW/CCW classifications NOT publicly redistributed. Comparison uses paper-quoted Table 3 axes + asymmetric 1sigma boxes only. Live-fire re-fit on Shamir's catalog is out of single-session scope. Outcome label uses paper-quoted comparison; cross-catalog depth is reduced (we trust Shamir's published axis without independent re-fit + Q-cuts variation + bootstrap diagnostics).
e2_catalog_access_subfinding.implication_for_outcome_strength: Headline outcome label A/C/D applies under the paper-quoted-axis comparison. The catalog-access blocker is a separate E2 sub-finding that does not change the primary outcome label but flags reduced cross-catalog independence depth.
